The 6-12 months of use indicates the reviewer has moved past initial setup and is likely engaging with more intermediate features like custom views. Therefore, a rating of 4 is most probable, with a good chance of 3 or 5, reflecting that while the functionality is present and designed for ease, specific implementation details can always vary in user experience."
